name: Animalia
source:
As the next leader of your people, you visit the Summit, a meeting of world leaders in a natural location. Your parents, the King and Queen, demand you find a marriage proposal while your here. Your options encompass the animal kin as they visit the Summit this year to strengthen the relationship between your races. Tensions are high between your races and may prove a challenge in your match. Choose your mate from among the lords and ladies and get swept away in the adventure of your courtship. Your choices will change the outcome of your life.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2597520/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
作为你们人民的下一任领导人，你将出席峰会，这是世界领导人在一个自然地点举行的会议。你的父母，国王和王后，要求你在这里求婚。你的选择包括动物亲属，因为他们今年将访问峰会，以加强你们种族之间的关系。比赛之间的紧张气氛可能会在比赛中成为一个挑战。从贵族和女士中选择你的伴侣，并沉浸在求爱的冒险中。你的选择将改变你人生的结果。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2597520/]Steam[/url]]
